scope: SSH controller and local store under Linux loopback kernel netem; no native renderer or model request

conditions.injector: Linux kernel netem on matched loopback SSH flow
conditions.limitation: Same-kernel loopback TCP; sender TCP Small Queues and kernel scheduling can differ from a physical WAN. Random loss is configured at 1%, not an exact observed percentage.
